canonicalRequirements.statement: Bind the GATE23 canonical mandate candidate by its exact SHA-256; the mandate is ratification only and grants neither START nor BUILD.

Bind the unpublished GATE23 prestart candidates A2-A5 (workset, mandate binding, checkpoint, closure evidence) by their exact SHA-256; they are not published canonical artifacts and this cohort does not publish them.
Preserve GATE23 as NOT_STARTED and GATE22 as COMPLETE_CONFIRMED; this cohort creates no ledger event, no state revision and no ACTIVE_GATE mutation.
The only authorized cohort is the precontract contract, its pointer and the primitive-generated consumption receipt; functional implementation stays unauthorized because START is not BUILD.
GATE21 and GATE22 surfaces stay unmodified; this cohort authorizes no GATE21 mutation, no GATE22 mutation, and no research/directional-lab write.
This document is a NON_ACTIVATED CANDIDATE. It grants neither START nor BUILD and does not activate CURRENT_CONTRACT.

requiredOutputs.role: Pointer to the exact versioned contract

positiveTests.case: the candidate contract and pointer bytes validate against the canonical contract schema
A1-A5 requiredInputs bind the verified candidate SHA-256 values exactly
GATE23 remains NOT_STARTED and GATE22 remains COMPLETE_CONFIRMED

negativeTests.case: START, BUILD or lifecycle transition request under this candidate
any write to a GATE21 or GATE22 surface or to research/directional-lab
publication of A1-A5 or of this candidate at a canonical repository path under this cohort
any write outside the three authorized contract paths

countertests.case: this candidate presented as an activated CURRENT_CONTRACT for GATE23
this candidate presented as a consumed Owner START authority
mandate bytes changed after this binding

reuseRules: Reuse the GATE22 precontract cohort format and the existing GEE precontract primitives without modification.
Reuse the verified A1-A5 candidate SHA-256 values; do not reserialize or republish them.
Reuse GATE22 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED as the sole predecessor terminal proof.
invalidationRules: Any drift of a hash-pinned required input blocks this candidate.
Any loss of GATE22 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED blocks this candidate.
Any change of GATE23 away from NOT_STARTED blocks this candidate.
Any GATE21 or GATE22 mutation blocks this candidate.
closureConditions: This document is a NON_ACTIVATED CANDIDATE. It is not published at governance/gates/GATE23/contracts/, it is not pointed to by any live CURRENT_CONTRACT and no authority has been consumed for it in the repository.
This candidate is not closure, not confirmation, not START and not BUILD.
A later separately authorized lifecycle may publish an identical contract at the canonical path only under its own Owner authority.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: No next-Gate authorization is created by this candidate.

checkpointPolicy.resume: A1-A5 verified candidates; PRESTART_SERIALIZATION_COMPLETE; precontract bytes not published
checkpointPolicy.reuse: GATE22 precontract cohort format and GEE precontract primitives
checkpointPolicy.independentConfirmation: required separately before START is executed
